description: Returns a link that lets someone who is not at this machine watch and drive the attached `container` browser, for example to sign in. This server opens no tunnel itself. Step 1: call with no arguments. It returns the local viewer URL, the `cloudflared` command, and two `choices`. Ask the developer to pick one before any tunnel runs: (a, recommended) they run `! cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:<port>` themselves and paste the printed `https://*.trycloudflare.com` URL; (b) they explicitly approve you running the command in the background. Never install `cloudflared` without approval. Step 2: call again with the URL as `publicUrl` to get the link to relay. The link grants access to that browser session only, so share it only with the person who needs it. For `builder`, use the `liveViewUrl` from `attach_browser`.
name: share_browser_view
